findings.title: Skip links are not focusable. (1 instance) on http://localhost:5173/dashboard
findings.howToFix: Including a skip link can help users skip to the main content to save time. [Learn more about skip links](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/skip-link).

findings.title: Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order (1 instance) on http://localhost:5173/
findings.howToFix: Properly ordered headings that do not skip levels convey the semantic structure of the page, making it easier to navigate and understand when using assistive technologies. [Learn more about heading order](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/heading-order).
